original_question: Let phi be a bounded plurisubharmonic function on a domain Omega contained in C^n. When (phi_j) is any sequence of bounded plurisubharmonic functions converging to phi in L^1_loc, determine what can be said about the set of cluster points of the Monge-Ampere measures (dd^c phi_j)^n.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper’s target question very closely: it is local (a domain Ω ⊂ C^n), assumes φ is bounded plurisubharmonic, takes bounded plurisubharmonic approximants φ_j with φ_j → φ in L^1_loc, and asks about cluster points of the Monge-Ampère measures (dd^c φ_j)^n.
missing_details: The paper states this as an open problem ('what can be said about... ?'), not as a problem with a known determination.
The cluster points are cluster points in the weak topology on Radon measures on Ω.
Because each φ_j is bounded plurisubharmonic, (dd^c φ_j)^n is meant in the Bedford-Taylor sense.
No monotonicity assumption is present in this question; that is exactly what distinguishes it from the neighboring Question 1, where the approximants decrease to φ.
The paper says only that Ω is a domain in C^n; it does not impose boundedness of Ω in Question 2.
If one wants the notation to be fully stand-alone, one should say explicitly that no specific normalization of dd^c is essential here, only the resulting Bedford-Taylor Monge-Ampère measure.
refined_question: Let Ω ⊂ C^n be a domain, let φ ∈ PSH(Ω) ∩ L^∞(Ω), and let (φ_j) ⊂ PSH(Ω) ∩ L^∞(Ω) be a sequence such that φ_j → φ in L^1_loc(Ω). For each j, let (dd^c φ_j)^n denote the Bedford-Taylor complex Monge-Ampère measure of φ_j. What can be said about the set of weak cluster points, in the space of Radon measures on Ω, of the sequence of measures ((dd^c φ_j)^n)_j?
justification: The draft is clearly aiming at Bedford’s second local open question in the paper. In Section 1.1.1, after Definition 1.1, the authors recall that Bedford-Taylor define the complex Monge-Ampère operator for locally bounded plurisubharmonic functions and then note that this operator is not continuous for the L^1_loc-topology. They then ask, almost verbatim, the question your draft is trying to capture: given a bounded plurisubharmonic function φ on a domain Ω ⊂ C^n, what can be said about the set of cluster points of (dd^c φ_j)^n when φ_j are bounded plurisubharmonic functions converging to φ in L^1_loc? Definition 1.1 supplies the nearby measure-theoretic context of weak convergence to a Radon measure, and the adjacency to Question 1 makes clear that the absence of a monotone decreasing hypothesis is essential here. Although your prompt mentioned Conjecture 1.1, Proposition 1.2, and Theorem 1.3, this draft unmistakably targets Section 1.1.1, Question 2 instead.

citations.label: Bedford-Taylor well-definedness and L^1_loc non-continuity discussion preceding Question 2
